notes:
Mandatory inspection checklist completed against motionssalt/clipforge (bot/src/*, schemas/*, ARCHITECTURE.md). Key findings: Settings covers GitHub clone (visibility toggle, sync, disconnect, delete confirmation, and main-account only push-update & push-news), Narrator (12 Edge TTS voices from constants.js VOICES), Music library (default track in branding/music_default.json, browse audio-library/, upload with progress, multi-select delete), Watermark (branding/creator_watermark.json set/clear), Series Mode default (branding/series_settings.json), Zernio publishing (branding/zernio_settings.json, API key, connected accounts, enable/disable, clear-key confirmation). Source kinds: url, drive, magnet, torrent_file (<=1MB, uploaded to jobs/<id>/source.torrent with progress bar), telegram_channel (gated to main account via isOriginalRepo: repo === motionssalt/clipforge); telegram_relay excluded. Jobs state machine: queued -> stage_a_running -> awaiting_torrent_selection | awaiting_plan -> stage_b_queued -> stage_b_running -> complete | error | cancelled. Copy agent prompt extracts canonical hand-off prompt (target duration, focus, series metadata, JSON-only delivery) and copies to clipboard. Video save uses SAF to Movies/ClipForge/ without size limits.

SESSION-02 START (2026-09-11 UTC): reconciled with git history — tasks 02..11 marked done to reflect committed and previously-released v1 (release run 34642107939). Seeded task-12..task-19 for this update pass. clipforge-android-v1 tag/release was previously deleted outside this session — the release.yml auto-increment will now issue clipforge-android-v1 for this fix build (next available slot). No prior release will be overwritten.

tasks.title: Bug-fix #1 — Logs: replace static log dump with terminal-style auto-scrolling line-by-line log stream (append new lines only, auto-scroll to bottom, monospace, capped ring buffer).
tasks.notes: Rewrote log stream to be append-only: ClipForgeViewModel now diffs GitHub Actions step results and emits each step exactly once with a status marker (…/✓/✗/⏹/↷/•). TaskDetailScreen renders the log in a LazyColumn (140–260dp, monospace) with LaunchedEffect(logs.size) auto-scrolling to the last item, so it reads like a live terminal instead of a full dump. seenLogLines resets on startPollingTask/stopPollingTask so switching tasks starts a fresh timeline.

tasks.title: Bug-fix #2 — Settings: (a) reload settings each time Settings screen becomes active, (b) restore inputs from loaded values, (c) complete Zernio card (accounts list with refresh button + empty-state hint), (d) show explicit loading state.
tasks.notes: Settings screen now calls vm.loadSettings() via LaunchedEffect on entry (so persisted watermark/Zernio-key/narrator/series values populate the UI every time you open the tab). Added settingsLoading + settingsLoaded flags; screen shows an explicit 'Loading your saved settings…' banner instead of blank defaults. Watermark card shows the currently-saved value below the input. Zernio card completed: status chip (Active/Paused/No key), full Connected Channels section with a Refresh button, empty-state hint, and per-op inline spinners on Save/Refresh. loadSettings() now catches per-file exceptions so one missing branding file no longer kills the entire load.

tasks.title: Bug-fix #3 — Torrent tasks: implement awaiting_torrent_selection UI branch in TaskDetailScreen so the user can list files inside jobs/<id>/torrent_files.json (or status.torrent_files) and select the video to render.
tasks.notes: TaskDetailScreen now has a full awaiting_torrent_selection branch: reads video candidates from jobs/<id>/torrent_files.json (fallback: status.json torrent_files array) via VM loadTorrentFiles, shows a Select Video From Torrent card listing each candidate (name + size), submitting writes jobs/<id>/torrent-selection.json {selected_index}, re-dispatches stage-a.yml with input torrent_selected=<index>, updates status.json to stage_a_running, and clears the candidate list. Empty state shows an auto-refreshing waiting indicator; submitting shows a spinner. Torrent tasks no longer stall/fail at the selection step.

tasks.title: Bug-fix #4 — Startup crash on second launch: harden ClipForgeViewModel.init and CredentialStore against EncryptedSharedPreferences AEAD/KeyStore failures + move blocking network out of init.
tasks.notes: Wrap EncryptedSharedPreferences.create in try/catch; on failure clear the store file and rebuild. Remove refreshAll() out of init — schedule it in a viewModelScope coroutine so init never blocks and any exception cannot kill the Application launch. Also add global try/catch in AndroidViewModel init so any thrown error surfaces as a snack instead of a crash.

tasks.title: Bug-fix #5 — Loading indicators on API buttons (Connect, Sync, Save Watermark, Save Zernio, Toggle Visibility, Push Update, Push News, Delete Clone, Disconnect where async).
tasks.notes: Add per-action busy flags in VM (busyConnect, busySettings, busyBroadcast, etc.) or one busyOps map. Buttons disable + inline CircularProgressIndicator (size 16.dp) inside the button label while their coroutine runs.
